about: Ruling 78(f): the one table the 3D game draws its models from. src is own (the country's own model), shared (another country's, by the record; 'of' says whose) or generic. A tag not listed here takes _default. src captured (18 November 2026, Brian's rule for small nations' battleships and carriers): nothing shows until the country holds a great power's plans, by capture or by a spy; then it shows that great power's model named in captured_models[plans].models, in its own hull grey, flying its own ensign (and jack on a battleship). with_plans (ruling 235, b542) on a small nation's bomber or fighter: once it builds four-engined bombers or jet fighters, it draws captured_models[heavybombers or jets].models[the great power capitalPlans names], in its own paint and marking. captured_models keys are the rules' capitalPlans keys; column says which column each serves. Colours are hex. Art director, 16 November 2026. with_tech {tech id: model} shows that model once the country has researched it. swaps {swap name: [[from month YYYY-MM or null for the start, the file's choice], ...]} picks a model's swap by date. carrier_fighter, torpedo_bomber, dive_bomber and carrier_paint are for after release 1, as is a model named under after_release_1.
